title: Expose invoice evidence summary in Purchase Order workflows
description: Expose a read-only invoice-evidence summary in existing Purchase Order list and detail workflows by reusing ERP-043 persisted allocations and ERP-044 reconciliation semantics. Do not create another invoice schema, infer invoice links, change Purchase Order status, claim payment settlement or payable balance, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Purchase Order detail shows recorded non-void allocated invoice amount, remaining uninvoiced amount, invoice count and explicit coverage state using only persisted ERP-043 allocation rows.
Purchase Order list exposes a bounded invoice-coverage summary without issuing a database query per row.

Draft and voided invoice evidence is distinguished from active recorded evidence and does not inflate the active invoiced total; historical evidence remains inspectable through an explicit detail view.
Supplier and currency mismatches are displayed as invalid or unavailable historical evidence and are never silently converted, merged or reassigned.
Orders with no invoice evidence remain readable and display no evidence or unknown as appropriate rather than paid, settled or overdue.
The UI clearly labels the values as purchase-invoice evidence and not accounts-payable balance, payment authorization, tax eligibility or settlement status.
Invoice summaries do not alter Purchase Order status, receipt progress, settlement-progress text, inventory cost, payments, supplier balance, expenses or tax-refund records.
Queries are bounded and reuse the authoritative amount and currency rules from ERP-043/ERP-044 instead of duplicating reconciliation logic.

Unit/integration tests cover no evidence, full and partial allocation, multiple invoices, draft and void history, mismatched historical evidence, bounded list queries and non-mutation; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open a Purchase Order with partial recorded invoice allocation and verify the linked amount, remaining uninvoiced amount, count and coverage state match the invoice register.
Inspect an order with voided or no invoice evidence and verify it is not presented as payable, paid, settled or overdue and that no Purchase Order field is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only presentation of existing invoice allocations. No production mutation, payable posting, payment, tax action, deployment or release is authorized.
